name: com.felkertech.channelsurfer.auto.ExoPlayerAudio
description: ChannelSurfer exposes this Service to Android media clients that request a media browser. It creates an empty media session and returns no media items; its play, pause, and seek controls have no behavior.
disableEffect: Android media clients will no longer discover this empty media service; the component currently exposes no playable items or working playback controls.
